source_note: Two saved EIG/Savills appearances for detached former school houses were resolved only after matching their exact property descriptions and saved profile photographs to independent address records. The October 2014 Lewisham lot's £501,000 result uniquely matches HM Land Registry's £501,000 first recorded sale of School House, Ardmere Road on 26 November 2014; a 2015 planning record independently describes the same building as the former school keeper's cottage. The March 2013 Brockley lot's distinctive brick-and-red-quoin facade, gabled roof form and position beside a school match the later sale brochure for The Old School House, Gordonbrock Road; that brochure explicitly identifies it as a detached former schoolhouse, while Royal Mail PAF and property/EPC records supply the complete address. No identity was inferred from locality alone.
